units: percent of installed TIV per year
scope_note: Source-pathway / normalization layer, NOT a calibration harness. No pass/fail bands. Tail metrics (PML, OEP/AEP, VaR, TVaR) are out of scope and deferred to a separate artifact.

rows.Reasoning: Stowing plus thicker glass collapses DR by ~5-10x at the same stone size. Upper bound is pinned to the observed resilient-design AAL, not extrapolated.
rows.Reference: Empirical: kWh/POWER Mag resilient case $307,790/yr per 100MW = 0.275% TIV/yr [KWH_POWERMAG_RESILIENCY_CASE_2025] | Curve: HAIL_SOLAR_HARDENED_THICKER fully_stowed, 50-60mm -> 1.53-5.20% TIV

rows.Reasoning: Central case. Empirical and engineering streams independently land on the same interval - convergence of two independent methods.
rows.Reference: Empirical: kWh/POWER Mag baseline $1,062,720/yr per 100MW = 0.949% TIV/yr [KWH_POWERMAG_RESILIENCY_CASE_2025] | Curve: HAIL_SOLAR_DEFAULT_3P2_GBS fully_stowed @55mm = 8.95% TIV

rows.Reasoning: Hail alley sites take repeated sub-catastrophic strikes so annual losses stack - EAL is not one event. Upper bound does not extrapolate past the observed 1-in-100 threshold.
rows.Reference: Empirical: AXIS $340k-$380k/MW = 30.4-33.9% TIV [AXIS_SOLAR_VS_HAIL_2025]; GCube sensitivity $584k/MW = 52.1% TIV [GCUBE_HAIL_NO_2023_PUBLIC_SUMMARIES]; kWh SRA 1-in-100 hail loss >10% asset value [KWH_SRA_2026_OPEN_PAGE] | Curve: HAIL_SOLAR_DEFAULT_3P2_GBS unstowed @60mm = 27.39% TIV; asymptote 35.47% @90mm

rows.Reasoning: Solar is preferentially sited off floodplain so exposure probability dominates and is very small.
rows.Reference: Empirical: Valdora Solar $0/MW - a real flood event with zero physical loss [VALDORA_SOLAR_ZERO_LOSS_2022] | Curve: Value-weighted FS failure units @0.15m = 17.53% TIV

rows.Reasoning: Order of magnitude consistent with the peril-mix derived figure, which implies flood is a rounding error in aggregate solar loss.
rows.Reference: Empirical: VDE/AXIS peril mix derived $32.61/MW = 0.003% TIV aggregate [VDE_AXIS_PERIL_MIX_2025] | Curve: Value-weighted FS failure units @0.30m = 28.56% TIV

rows.Reasoning: Asymmetry is the story: conditional severity is high (inverters and switchgear drown at ankle depth) but annual expectation stays small.
rows.Reference: Empirical: DEPCOM avoided-loss $43,478/MW = 3.88% TIV event-scale [DEPCOM_FLOOD_RESPONSE_CASE] | Curve: Value-weighted FS failure units @0.3m = 28.56% TIV, @1.0m = 41.98% TIV; asymptote 45.92% @4.0m

rows.Reasoning: The DR curve is exactly zero below 100mph - sub-design gusts contribute nothing to EAL.
Empirical support is indirect - no open source isolates pure straight-line-wind dollar severity for solar.
rows.Reference: Empirical: Soltec 2019 ~2% of trackers collapsed/damaged - a low-severity real outcome [SOLTEC_2019_PVMAG] | Curve: struct_agg_pct_installed_TIV @115mph = 9.37% TIV

rows.Reasoning: Tracker stow reliability is the swing factor - NEXTracker 25-yr failure probability spans 1.7-14.6%, an ~8x spread that maps directly onto this band width.
rows.Reference: Empirical: AXIS $150k-$380k/MW = 13.4-33.9% TIV (stow scenarios, hail-framed, blended use) [AXIS_RENEWABLE_2024]; DOE FEMP repair range 0.9%-134% TIV [DOE_FEMP_PV_WEATHER_GUIDE] | Curve: struct_agg_pct_installed_TIV @120mph = 15.13% TIV, @130mph = 25.32% TIV; asymptote 31.74%

rows.Reasoning: Turbines are engineered to IEC Ve50 survival so straight-line convective wind essentially never governs.
Tornado severity is capped by geometry not strength - only ~10% of farm footprint sits in the damage corridor.
Lowest-EAL pair in the package - both severity (corridor-capped) and frequency (point-strike probability) are small.
rows.Reference: Empirical: No open empirical loss row exists; only the NREL value basis is populated [SRC_NREL_CWER_2024] | Curve: struct_agg_pct_TIV_TOR @190.1mph = 3.97% TIV; asymptote 5.55% @257mph

rows.Reasoning: Order-of-magnitude placeholder only. Must not be cited as a finding.
rows.Reference: Empirical: 0 of 100 catalogued rows normalize to %TIV | Curve: Upstream status RESOLVED_GRAIN_DR_WITHHELD - no runtime DR curve. Hazard axis FSIM_CONDITIONAL_FLAME_LENGTH_PROBABILITY (USFS FSIM RDS 2023, 270m) is a conditional probability given burning and still requires an unconditional burn probability to become an EAL.

rows.Reasoning: Burnover of a utility-scale PV site is rare; gravel pads and vegetation management create fuel breaks. Value at risk if burnover occurs is the thermal-exposed stack, but no DR ordinates exist to apply to it.
rows.Reference: Empirical: Value basis available: WS_MODULE_THERMAL $291,215/MW = 26.0% TIV; WS_RACKING_THERMAL $109,990/MW = 9.8% TIV | Curve: Upstream status RESOLVED_GRAIN_DR_WITHHELD - no runtime DR curve. Hazard axis FSIM_CONDITIONAL_FLAME_LENGTH_PROBABILITY (USFS FSIM RDS 2023, 270m) is a conditional probability given burning and still requires an unconditional burn probability to become an EAL.

rows.Reasoning: CAVEAT THAT MATERIALLY CHANGES INTERPRETATION: much of the reported fire loss in PV portfolios is equipment-origin (combiner/connector arcing), not regional wildfire burnover. Those are a different peril and must not be pooled into a wildfire EAL.
